objects.ConfigProposal: key + baseVersion + proposed safe value + validation result

read_model: OperationalConfigReadService returns explicit safe allowlist; never serialize raw config files or secret fields.

persistence.ConfigObservation: Platform operational config source read model

invariants: UI preferences never modify operational configuration

Default is observation/proposal until newer mutation authority exists
Reset means discard proposal/reveal present value, not factory-reset production

epistemic.empty: Whitelist has no visible keys: explicit empty scope, not all-config dump.

epistemic.unavailable: Config source inaccessible: unknown value; never substitute defaults as observed fact.
epistemic.error: Sensitive/unknown key rejected before storage/logging; safe reason only.
